summary.text: Crovax is an aristocratic human nobleman of Urborg who joined the Weatherlight crew, became a vampire after killing the angel Selenia, and then became the Phyrexian Evincar of Rath.

bio.text: Crovax left Urborg with the artifact binding Selenia to join the Weatherlight crew, and Phyrexian agents slaughtered his family.
He shattered the artifact and Selenia flew away, leaving him cursed to destroy all that he loved.
On Rath he struck down Selenia in the Dream Halls, and her shards warped him into a vampire.
He killed Mirri after she followed him onto the deck and they fell into Volrath's garden.
Taken to Phyrexia, Kirril compleated him and groomed him as evincar of Rath.
He defeated Greven, impaled 6,000 hostages on flowstone spikes after the failed Skyshroud assault, forced Belbe to name him evincar and defeated Volrath in a duel with Ertai's help.
After the Rathi Overlay he oversaw Phyrexian domination of Urborg, executed Tsabo Tavoc, and tried to convince Gerrard to submit to Yawgmoth.
Gerrard sliced Crovax in half in the Stronghold throne room.

status.text: Crovax is dead, killed by Gerrard in the Stronghold, and Selenia recovered his normal soul.
